questions.question: Match the following subsectors to revenue, EBITDA and earnings: Internet, Software, Semiconductors?
questions.answer: Internet - Revenue (many of them are consumer facing and are losing money to reach critical mass, right now have a miniscule gross profit like Uber, and an even smaller EBITDA because of marketing) Semiconductors - P/E (factors in D&A/capex, can still be EV/EBITDA if in the same location and don’t have too much debt+capex, like local fabless companies) Software - EV/EBITDA (method of elimination, push back, should be EV/FCF because cash is locked up in deferred revenue)
